landing.contextTitle: Kuva mu mirima y'u Rwanda kugeza ku isuzuma ry'ako kanya
landing.contextText1: Indwara z'ibihingwa zishobora kurimbura umusaruro w'igihembwe cyose mbere y'uko umuhinzi agera ku mpuguke. Agri AI ifunga iyo nkunga — ifoto yafatiwe mu murima iba isuzuma mu masegonda, rikazasuzumwa n'agworonome uzuri ukarere kawe.
landing.contextText2: Buri cyitegererezo gifite amakuru y'ikirere k'aho uherereye: imvura, ubushyuhe n'ubushuhe bw'ikirere — kugira ngo inama zihuze n'urugori rwawe, ntabwo ari iz'igitabo gisanzwe.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Iyandikishe ukoresheje kode uhabwa na koperative yawe, utangire kumenya indwara uyu munsi.
landing.madeIn: Byubatswe ku bahinzi bo mu Rwanda

footer.secure: Uruhare rukurikirana — abahinzi, abagworonome, koperative, abayobozi
